title: Herbal Springy Tunisian Rye Bread Flatbread
description: A refreshing and nutritious flatbread perfect for post-workout snacking. Made with rye flour, herbs, and a touch of olive oil.
instructions: Combine rye flour, olive oil, water, rosemary, thyme, and garlic in a large bowl.
Mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough on a floured surface for 5 minutes, until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a lightly oiled bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium-high heat.
Divide the dough into 4-6 equal pieces, depending on desired flatbread size.
Roll each piece into a ball and then flatten into a disk using a rolling pin or your hands.
Cook the flatbreads for 2-3 minutes per side, until golden brown and crispy.
Transfer the cooked flatbreads to a wire rack to cool.
Brush with olive oil and season with salt and pepper before serving.
